integrity: Exact analytic recurrence, uniform pre-exit bounds, and executable finite checker are included. Numerical checks are not proofs.
scientific_limitations: The result is at fixed neutral gain and symmetric payoff only, for small fixed exit thresholds and nonexceptional diagonal starts. No nonlinear post-exit rate or joint near-critical parameter law is claimed.
title: A logarithmic-logarithmic separation clock at a neutral learning bifurcation
